verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.109
11. Clouds
Trees
“Mendicants, there are these four kinds of tree.
What four?
One is a softwood surrounded by softwoods,
one is a softwood surrounded by hardwoods,
one is a hardwood surrounded by softwoods, and
one is a hardwood surrounded by hardwoods.
These are the four kinds of tree.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro rukkhūpamā puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: In the same way, these four individuals similar to trees are found in the world.
What four?
One is a softwood surrounded by softwoods,
one is a softwood surrounded by hardwoods,
one is a hardwood surrounded by softwoods, and
one is a hardwood surrounded by hardwoods.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo pheggu hoti phegguparivāro?
verses.english: And how is an individual a softwood surrounded by softwoods?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo;
verses.english: It’s when an individual is unethical, of bad character,
and their followers are the same.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo pheggu hoti phegguparivāro.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is a softwood surrounded by softwoods.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, rukkho pheggu phegguparivāro;
verses.english: That individual is like a softwood tree that’s surrounded by softwoods, I say.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo pheggu hoti sāraparivāro?
verses.english: And how is an individual a softwood surrounded by hardwoods?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo;
verses.english: It’s when an individual is unethical, of bad character,

verses.pali: parisā ca khvassa hoti sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā.
verses.english: but their followers are ethical, of good character. …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo pheggu hoti sāraparivāro.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, rukkho pheggu sāraparivāro;
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo sāro hoti phegguparivāro?
verses.english: And how is an individual a hardwood surrounded by softwoods?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo;
verses.english: It’s when an individual is ethical, of good character,

verses.pali: parisā ca khvassa hoti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
verses.english: but their followers are unethical, of bad character. …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo sāro hoti phegguparivāro.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, rukkho sāro phegguparivāro;
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo sāro hoti sāraparivāro?
verses.english: And how is an individual a hardwood surrounded by hardwoods?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo;
verses.english: It’s when an individual is ethical, of good character,
and their followers are the same.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo sāro hoti sāraparivāro.
Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, rukkho sāro sāraparivāro;
Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro rukkhūpamā puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These four individuals similar to trees are found in the world.”
